```{r}
data_raw <- read_excel("mole crabs fixed swash and temp.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    water_temp = as.numeric(str_extract(water_temp, "[0-9.]+")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(year(date))
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # ===========================
    # STANDARDIZE LOCATION
    # ===========================
    location = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(location), "brighton|bluff") ~ "bluffs",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "south bath|bath ave") ~ "south_bath",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "deal|allenhurst|roosevelt") ~ "deal",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "ocean grove") ~ "ocean_grove",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "sandy hook") ~ "sandy_hook",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WAVES
    # ===========================
    waves_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "small|\\bsm\\b") ~ "Small",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "med") ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "large|rough|3-5") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ZONE
    # ===========================
    zone = tolower(zone),
    zone = case_when(
      str_detect(zone, "bore")  ~ "bore",
      str_detect(zone, "swash|surf") ~ "swash",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ENVIRONMENTAL NUMERIC VARIABLES
    # ===========================
    salinity = as.numeric(str_extract(salinity, "[0-9.]+")),
    do_mg_l_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(do_mg_l, "[0-9.]+")),
    air_temp_deg_c = as.numeric(str_extract(air_temp_deg_c, "[0-9.]+")),

    # ===========================
    # FIX DO
    # ===========================
    do_mg_l = case_when(
      do_mg_l_raw > 20 ~ NA_real_,
      do_mg_l_raw <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ do_mg_l_raw
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN MOON PHASE
    # ===========================
    moon_phase_clean = tolower(moon_phase),
    moon_phase_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "full") ~ "Full",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "first|waxing") ~ "Waxing",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "last|waning") ~ "Waning",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "quarter|quater") ~ "Quarter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN TIDE STAGE
    # ===========================
    tide_clean = tolower(tide_stage),
    tide_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tide_clean, "high") ~ "High",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "low|\\bl\\b") ~ "Low",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "rising|flood|incoming") ~ "Rising",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "falling|ebb") ~ "Falling",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN SKY
    # ===========================
    sky_clean = tolower(sky),
    sky_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(sky_clean, "clear|sun") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "part") ~ "Partly Cloudy",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "cloud") ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN FOAM
    # ===========================
    foam_clean = tolower(foam_floatables_y_n),
    foam_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(foam_clean, "y|foam") ~ "Foam",
      str_detect(foam_clean, "n|none|little") ~ "No Foam",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WATER CLARITY
    # ===========================
    water_clean = tolower(water_color_transparency),
    water_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(water_clean, "clear|transparent|high transparency") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(water_clean, "murky|low transparency|dark|brown|grey|cloudy") ~ "Murky",
      str_detect(water_clean, "green|olive|yellow|blue") ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  # Remove helper column
  dplyr::select(-do_mg_l_raw) %>%

  # Keep valid locations only
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%

  mutate(
  location = factor(location),
  year = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))),
  waves_clean = factor(waves_clean, levels = c("Small","Medium","Large")),
  zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
  moon_phase_clean = factor(moon_phase_clean,
                            levels = c("Waxing","Full","Waning","Quarter")),
  tide_clean = factor(tide_clean,
                      levels = c("Low","Rising","High","Falling")),
  sky_clean = factor(sky_clean,
                     levels = c("Clear","Partly Cloudy","Cloudy")),
  foam_clean = factor(foam_clean,
                      levels = c("No Foam","Foam")),
  water_clean = factor(water_clean,
                       levels = c("Clear","Moderate","Murky"))
) %>%
droplevels()
global_temp_mean <- mean(clean_data$water_temp, na.rm = TRUE)


clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year == "2023" ~ "Disturbance",
      year == "2024" ~ "Collapse",
      year == "2025" ~ "Recovery"
    ),
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance","Collapse","Recovery")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE LONG FORMAT SIZE DATA
# ----------------------------------

size_data <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    water_temp,
    salinity,
    do_mg_l,
    air_temp_deg_c,
    waves_clean,
    location,
    year,
    phase,
    zone,
    groin,            
    scoops,
    ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    ct_2mm  = as.numeric(ct_2mm),
    ct_6mm  = as.numeric(ct_6mm),
    ct_12mm = as.numeric(ct_12mm),
    
    # Clean  
    groin = case_when(
      groin %in% c("N","n") ~ "North",
      groin %in% c("S","s") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("ct_2mm","ct_6mm","ct_12mm"),
      labels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South")),
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    q25 = quantile(count, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(count, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(quartiles_year)

# ----------------------------------
# Observed 2024 Decline
# ----------------------------------

decline_table <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(total = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm) %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2024")) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_total = mean(total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_total)

baseline_mean <- mean(c(decline_table$`2021`,
                        decline_table$`2022`))

decline <- 1 - (decline_table$`2024` / baseline_mean)

cat("Observed 2024 decline:",
    round(decline * 100, 1), "%\n")
# ----------------------------------

# ----------------------------------

spatial_summary <- size_data %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_prop = mean(count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

print(spatial_summary)

# ----------------------------------
# Dispersion Metrics (NB Justification)
# ----------------------------------

mean_count <- mean(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)
var_count  <- var(size_data$count, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Overall mean:", mean_count, "\n")
cat("Overall variance:", var_count, "\n")
cat("Variance-to-Mean ratio:",
    var_count / mean_count, "\n")
```

```{r}
site_coords <- data.frame(
  location = c("sandy_hook","bluffs","south_bath","deal","ocean_grove"),
  lat = c(40.445, 40.300, 40.292, 40.245, 40.210),
  lon = c(-73.990, -74.000, -74.003, -74.025, -74.010)
)

site_summary <- left_join(site_summary, site_coords, by = "location")

# Clean labels
site_summary$location_clean <- dplyr::recode(site_summary$location,
  sandy_hook  = "Sandy Hook",
  bluffs      = "Bluffs",
  south_bath  = "South Bath",
  deal        = "Deal",
  ocean_grove = "Ocean Grove"
)

# ----------------------------------
# Label positioning (original spacing)
# ----------------------------------

site_summary <- site_summary %>%
  mutate(
    label_lon = lon - 0.025,
    label_lat = case_when(
      location == "sandy_hook" ~ lat + 0.01,
      location == "bluffs" ~ lat + 0.010,
      location == "south_bath" ~ lat - 0.010,
      location == "deal" ~ lat - 0.005,
      location == "ocean_grove" ~ lat - 0.008,
      TRUE ~ lat
    )
  )

# ----------------------------------
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# OBSERVED TEMPORAL TREND
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ==========================================

observed_size <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_per_scoop = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_per_scoop - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_per_scoop + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year))
  )

ggplot(observed_size,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_per_scoop,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(observed_size$year_num))
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Abundance (Crabs per Scoop)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temporal Abundance by Size Class"
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# OBSERVED TEMPERATURE RELATIONSHIP
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)
# ----------------------------------

# ---- Add per-scoop standardization ----
size_data_temp <- size_data %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    cps = count / scoops   # crabs per scoop
  )

# ---- Binned summary ----
obs_temp <- size_data_temp %>%
  mutate(temp_bin = round(water_temp * 2) / 2) %>%   # 0.5°C bins
  group_by(size_class, temp_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cps = mean(cps, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(cps, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5)

ggplot() +
  
  # ---- Raw data points ----
  geom_jitter(
    data = size_data_temp,
    aes(x = water_temp,
        y = pmax(cps, 0.01),
        color = size_class),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- SE ribbon ----
  geom_ribbon(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        ymin = pmax(mean_cps - se, 0.01),
        ymax = mean_cps + se,
        fill = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean line ----
  geom_line(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_cps,
        color = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean points ----
  geom_point(
    data = obs_temp,
    aes(x = temp_bin,
        y = mean_cps,
        color = size_class),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(0.05, 150),
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# CRAMÉR'S V — BASELINE vs DISTURBANCE
# (SCOOP-WEIGHTED VERSION)
# ==========================================

struct_data <- clean_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year %in% c("2023","2024") ~ "Disturbance"
    ),
    total = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period),
         total > 0) %>%   # exclude zero-total samples for composition test
  mutate(
    dominant_size = case_when(
      ct_2mm  >= ct_6mm & ct_2mm  >= ct_12mm ~ "Small",
      ct_6mm  >= ct_2mm & ct_6mm  >= ct_12mm ~ "Medium",
      ct_12mm >= ct_2mm & ct_12mm >= ct_6mm  ~ "Large"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(period, dominant_size) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),      # <-- scoop-weighted
    .groups = "drop"
  )

matrix_bd <- xtabs(n_samples ~ period + dominant_size,
                   data = struct_data)

chi_disturbance <- chisq.test(matrix_bd)

# Cramér's V
n_bd <- sum(matrix_bd)
min_dim_bd <- min(dim(matrix_bd) - 1)

cramers_v_disturbance <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_disturbance$statistic) /
  (n_bd * min_dim_bd)
)

print(matrix_bd)
print(chi_disturbance)
print(cramers_v_disturbance)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# SYSTEMATIC TWO-WAY INTERACTION TEST
# (All pairwise interactions in one chunk)
# ==========================================
# ------------------------------------------
# 1. Baseline main-effects model
# ------------------------------------------

nb_main <- glmmTMB(
  count ~ log_scoops  +
          year + zone + size_class + water_temp_c +
          (1 | date) + (1 | location),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = analysis_data
)

# ------------------------------------------
# 2. Define variables to test
# ------------------------------------------

vars <- c("year",
          "zone",
          "size_class",
          "water_temp_c",
          "location")

two_way_terms <- combn(vars, 2,
                       FUN = function(x) paste(x, collapse=":"))

# ------------------------------------------
# 3. Test each interaction via LRT
# ------------------------------------------

interaction_results <- lapply(two_way_terms, function(term){

  model_int <- update(nb_main,
                      as.formula(paste(". ~ . +", term)))

  test <- anova(nb_main, model_int)

  data.frame(
    Interaction = term,
    Chisq = test$Chisq[2],
    Df = test$Df[2],
    p_value = test$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    Delta_AIC = AIC(model_int) - AIC(nb_main)
  )
})

interaction_results <- do.call(rbind, interaction_results) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

# ------------------------------------------
# 4. Print ranked results
# ------------------------------------------

print(interaction_results)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# THERMAL HEAT MAP
# ==========================================

coefs    <- fixef(nb_full_interaction)$cond
vcov_mat <- vcov(nb_full_interaction)$cond

levels_year <- levels(analysis_data$year)
levels_size <- levels(analysis_data$size_class)

thermal <- expand.grid(
  year       = levels_year,
  size_class = levels_size,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

thermal$slope  <- NA_real_
thermal$lower  <- NA_real_
thermal$upper  <- NA_real_
thermal$z      <- NA_real_
thermal$signif <- ""

# ------------------------------------------
# Compute temperature slopes correctly
# slope = (water_temp_c:size_class)
#       + (year:size_class:water_temp_c)
# ------------------------------------------

for(i in seq_len(nrow(thermal))){

  y <- thermal$year[i]
  s <- thermal$size_class[i]

  terms <- character(0)

  # Baseline slope for size
  base_term <- paste0("water_temp_c:size_class", s)

  # Year-specific deviation
  year_term <- paste0("year", y, ":water_temp_c:size_class", s)

  if(base_term %in% names(coefs))
    terms <- c(terms, base_term)

  if(year_term %in% names(coefs))
    terms <- c(terms, year_term)

  beta <- sum(coefs[terms])

  # Delta method SE
  L <- rep(0, length(coefs))
  names(L) <- names(coefs)
  L[terms] <- 1

  var_beta <- as.numeric(t(L) %*% vcov_mat %*% L)
  se_beta  <- sqrt(var_beta)

  thermal$slope[i] <- beta
  thermal$lower[i] <- beta - 1.96 * se_beta
  thermal$upper[i] <- beta + 1.96 * se_beta

  if(!is.na(se_beta) && se_beta > 0){
    z_val <- beta / se_beta
    thermal$z[i] <- z_val
    thermal$signif[i] <- ifelse(abs(z_val) > 1.96, "*", "")
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------
# Factor ordering
# ------------------------------------------

thermal$year <- factor(
  thermal$year,
  levels = c("2021","2022","2023","2024","2025")
)

thermal$size_class <- factor(
  thermal$size_class,
  levels = c("Small (2mm)",
             "Medium (6mm)",
             "Large (12mm+)")
)
# ------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------

max_abs <- max(abs(thermal$slope), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(thermal,
       aes(x = year,
           y = size_class,
           fill = slope)) +

  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(slope, 2), signif)),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4DB6AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
    name = "Thermal Slope\n(log IRR per +1°C)"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Size Class",
    title = "Thermal Filtering Reversal",
    subtitle = "Size-specific temperature response shifts from facilitation to suppression during collapse"
  )
# ------------------------------------------
# Mean thermal slope by year
# ------------------------------------------

year_means <- thermal %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_slope   = sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("PRIMARY MODEL DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("=============================\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------
# 1️⃣ Convergence & Hessian
# -----------------------------------------------------

cat("Convergence code:\n")
print(nb_full_interaction$fit$convergence)

cat("\nPositive-definite Hessian:\n")
print(nb_full_interaction$sdr$pdHess)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# 2️⃣ Rank / Identifiability
# -----------------------------------------------------

mm <- model.matrix(
  count ~ log_scoops + zone + year +
        water_temp_c:size_class +
        zone:size_class +
        year:size_class +
        year:size_class:zone +
        year:size_class:water_temp_c,
  data = analysis_data
)

cat("\nRank check:\n")
cat("Model rank:", qr(mm)$rank, "of", ncol(mm), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------
# 3️⃣ Negative Binomial Dispersion Parameter
# -----------------------------------------------------

cat("\nDispersion parameter (sigma):\n")
print(sigma(nb_full_interaction))

# If sigma very small (<0.2) = extreme overdispersion
# If sigma very large = Poisson-like

# -----------------------------------------------------
# 4️⃣ Pearson Residual Diagnostics
# -----------------------------------------------------

pearson_resid <- residuals(nb_full_interaction, type = "pearson")
fitted_vals   <- fitted(nb_full_interaction)

cat("\nResidual summary:\n")
print(summary(pearson_resid))

cat("\nResidual mean (should be ~0):\n")
print(mean(pearson_resid))

cat("\nResidual SD (should be ~1 for NB):\n")
print(sd(pearson_resid))

cat("\nResidual vs fitted correlation (should be near 0):\n")
print(cor(pearson_resid, fitted_vals))

# Plot residual pattern
plot(fitted_vals, pearson_resid,
     xlab = "Fitted values",
     ylab = "Pearson residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# -----------------------------------------------------
# 5️⃣ Approximate Overdispersion Check
# -----------------------------------------------------

disp_ratio <- sum(pearson_resid^2) / df.residual(nb_full_interaction)

cat("\nOverdispersion ratio:\n")
print(disp_ratio)

# Ideal ≈ 1
# >1.5 moderate concern
# >2 serious concern

# -----------------------------------------------------
# 6️⃣ Random Effects Variance
# -----------------------------------------------------

cat("\nRandom effects variance:\n")
print(VarCorr(nb_full_interaction))

# Check if variances are near zero

# -----------------------------------------------------
# 7️⃣ Multicolinearity (Approximate VIF)
# -----------------------------------------------------

lm_approx <- lm(
  count ~ log_scoops + zone + year +
        size_class:water_temp_c +
        zone:size_class +
        year:size_class +
        year:size_class:zone +
        year:size_class:water_temp_c,
  data = analysis_data
)

cat("\nVariance Inflation Factors:\n")
print(vif(lm_approx))

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("END DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("=============================\n")
```

```{r}
    Recruitment_Proportion =
      `2025_Large (12mm+)` /
      `2024_Medium (6mm)`,

    Recruitment_Percent =
      round(Recruitment_Proportion * 100, 1)
  )

print(recruit_overall)

overall_recruit_percent <- recruit_overall$Recruitment_Percent
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# NOAA CO-OPS REGIONAL TEMPERATURE (Sandy Hook)
# September–October Means (2021–2025)
# Is cooling regional or local?
# ==========================================
library(readr)

get_sep_oct_clean <- function(year){
  
  url <- paste0(
    "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter?",
    "product=water_temperature",
    "&station=8531680",
    "&begin_date=", year, "0901",
    "&end_date=", year, "1031",
    "&units=metric",
    "&time_zone=gmt",
    "&format=csv",
    "&interval=h"
  )
  
  df <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    filter(!grepl("Date", date_time)) %>%  # remove header/footer artifacts
    mutate(
      datetime = ymd_hms(date_time, quiet = TRUE),
      water_temperature = as.numeric(water_temperature)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(datetime),
           !is.na(water_temperature))
  
  tibble(
    year = year,
    n_obs = nrow(df),
    min_temp = min(df$water_temperature),
    max_temp = max(df$water_temperature),
    mean_sep_oct_temp = mean(df$water_temperature)
  )
}

years <- 2021:2025

noaa_sep_oct_yearly <- bind_rows(lapply(years, get_sep_oct_clean))

print(noaa_sep_oct_yearly)

# ==========================================
# LOCAL SEPT–OCT TEMPERATURE MEANS
# ==========================================

local_sep_oct <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(as.character(year)),  # convert factor → integer
    month = month(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% 2021:2025,
    month %in% c(9,10)
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    local_mean = mean(water_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
temp_compare <- local_sep_oct %>%
  left_join(noaa_sep_oct_yearly %>%
              dplyr::select(year, mean_sep_oct_temp),
            by = "year") %>%
  rename(regional_mean = mean_sep_oct_temp) %>%
  mutate(
    anomaly = local_mean - regional_mean,
    disturbance = ifelse(year %in% c(2023,2024), 1, 0)
  )

print(temp_compare)
did_model <- lm(anomaly ~ disturbance, data = temp_compare)

summary(did_model)
did_model2 <- lm(local_mean ~ regional_mean + disturbance,
                 data = temp_compare)

summary(did_model2)
```

```{r disturbance_clock, eval=knitr::is_html_output()}
library(DiagrammeR)

# =====================================================
# MEAN BODY SIZE (Baseline vs Recovery)
# =====================================================

mean_size_df <- size_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2025")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_size = sum(count * size_mm) / sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_size_baseline <- round(
  mean(mean_size_df$mean_size[mean_size_df$year %in% c("2021","2022")]),
  1
)

mean_size_2025 <- round(
  mean_size_df$mean_size[mean_size_df$year == "2025"],
  1
)

size_decline <- round(
  100 * (1 - mean_size_2025 / mean_size_baseline),
  1
)

# =====================================================
# BIOMASS COLLAPSE
# =====================================================

biomass_year <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         zone %in% c("bore","swash")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy), .groups="drop")

baseline_bio <- mean(
  biomass_year$mean_biomass[biomass_year$year %in% c("2021","2022")]
)

collapse_bio <- biomass_year$mean_biomass[
  biomass_year$year == "2024"
]

collapse_pct <- round(
  100 * (1 - collapse_bio / baseline_bio),
  0
)

# =====================================================
# STRUCTURAL BREAK
# =====================================================

break_chi <- round(as.numeric(chi_disturbance$statistic), 2)
break_p   <- signif(chi_disturbance$p.value, 3)
break_v   <- round(cramers_v_disturbance, 2)

break_p_text <- ifelse(
  break_p < 0.001,
  "&lt; 0.001",
  paste0("= ", break_p)
)

# =====================================================
# DISTURBANCE IRR
# =====================================================

analysis_data$fit_resp <- predict(
  nb_full_interaction,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA
)

disturb_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(fit_resp), .groups = "drop")

irr_val <- round(
  disturb_summary$mean_pred[disturb_summary$year == "2024"] /
  disturb_summary$mean_pred[disturb_summary$year == "2021"],
  2
)

# =====================================================
# ZONE RECOVERY
# =====================================================

zone_recovery <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(zone, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(fit_resp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = mean_pred) %>%
  mutate(IRR = round(`2025` / `2021`, 2))

irr_recovery_bore  <- zone_recovery$IRR[zone_recovery$zone == "bore"]
irr_recovery_swash <- zone_recovery$IRR[zone_recovery$zone == "swash"]

# =====================================================
# ZONE BIOMASS RECOVERY
# =====================================================

biomass_zone <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         zone %in% c("bore","swash"),
         year %in% c("2021","2025")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(zone, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy), .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = mean_biomass) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(`2025` / `2021` * 100, 0))

swash_recovery <- biomass_zone$percent[biomass_zone$zone == "swash"]
bore_recovery  <- biomass_zone$percent[biomass_zone$zone == "bore"]

# =====================================================
# ADULT LOSS (LARGE SIZE CLASS)
# =====================================================

repro_loss <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         zone %in% c("bore","swash"),
         year %in% c("2021","2022","2023","2024")) %>%
  
  mutate(
    period = ifelse(year %in% c("2021","2022"),
                    "Baseline",
                    "Disturbance")
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    large_prop = sum(count[size_class == "Large (12mm+)"]) /
                 sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  summarise(
    loss = round(
      100 * (1 - large_prop[period == "Disturbance"] /
                 large_prop[period == "Baseline"]),
      1
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pull(loss)

# =====================================================
# RECRUITMENT FAILURE
# =====================================================

recruit_model <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2024","2025"),
         size_class %in% c("Medium (6mm)","Large (12mm+)")) %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(fit_resp), .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(year, size_class),
              values_from = mean_pred)

model_recruit_percent <- round(
  recruit_model$`2025_Large (12mm+)` /
  recruit_model$`2024_Medium (6mm)` * 100,
  1
)

# =====================================================
# OBSERVED RECRUITMENT
# =====================================================

overall_recruit_percent <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         year %in% c("2024","2025"),
         size_class %in% c("Medium (6mm)","Large (12mm+)")) %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(year, size_class),
              values_from = total) %>%
  mutate(p = round(`2025_Large (12mm+)` / `2024_Medium (6mm)` * 100,1)) %>%
  pull(p)

# =====================================================
# TEMPERATURE SHIFT
# =====================================================

baseline_temp <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022")) %>%
  summarise(mean_temp = round(mean(water_temp),2)) %>%
  pull(mean_temp)

disturb_temp <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2023","2024")) %>%
  summarise(mean_temp = round(mean(water_temp),2)) %>%
  pull(mean_temp)

# =====================================================
# MODEL-BASED ADULT LOSS (LARGE SIZE CLASS IRR)
# =====================================================

adult_model <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(size_class == "Large (12mm+)") %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year %in% c("2023","2024") ~ "Disturbance"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pred = mean(fit_resp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

adult_loss_irr <- round(
  adult_model$mean_pred[adult_model$period == "Disturbance"] /
  adult_model$mean_pred[adult_model$period == "Baseline"],
  2
)
```
